starting_branch_base: claude/zaad-capital-recovery-v7 (PR #37, V7 verdict NEEDS FURTHER CAPITAL / RECOVERY ENGINEERING)
pre_tuning_source_hash_scope: sha256 over path+bytes of sorted zaad/full/*.py then scripts/run_zaad_full_benchmark.py

validation7.status: RESERVED, UNRUN, never used; v8 does not reuse it

holdout4.status: FROZEN, UNRUN; run only on an explicit later instruction after validation8 passes

split_overlap_check: development8 (38001) and validation8 (39001, 39002) appear in no earlier split, in validation7, or in holdout4

solver_settings.note: solver_mip_gap stays at the historical 1e-6; the bounded-gap experiment was measured and rejected (decision-unstable on four of eight cells). comparable_gap is a new guard that is a no-op at this threshold on measured cells and is recorded so the setting is explicit.

runner_settings.writes: out-of-order on completion, deterministic order restored via task_index
runner_settings.cache: exact-result, keyed on source hash + cell + seed + method + solver settings
runner_settings.scheduling: longest-processing-time-first by horizon and network size, deterministic
runner_settings.workers: measured scaling 1/3/6/12 workers = 151/64/41/35 s on eight gated cells; effectively single-threaded MILP, no nested-parallelism pathology

comparators: robust (where the solver completes; timeout rows kept visible)

graduation_gates.normal_feasible: median service >= .97 where physically achievable; near-zero avoidable breaches; no feasibility violations; segmented targets respected
graduation_gates.constrained: reported against the physically achievable frontier and a competent incumbent, with avoidable and unavoidable shortage separated
graduation_gates.capital: 10-15% against a competent baseline where improvement is available; NO MATERIAL IMPROVEMENT AVAILABLE is a valid and preferred outcome elsewhere
graduation_gates.cost: no material modelled economic regression; one-time working-capital release never added to recurring saving
graduation_gates.runtime: SLOs in INDUSTRY_STANDARD_V8 section 4.1; report median, p90, p95, max and timeouts by planner type
graduation_gates.solve_quality: report achieved gap distribution and candidate slots lost to non-OPTIMAL status
graduation_gates.explainability: every selected action carries a reason code and supporting metrics
graduation_gates.abstention: the competent incumbent is retained where no material improvement exists

intended_analyses: Part C: reduce the 12% unexplained inventory attribution toward zero with strict reconciliation tests
Part D: full inventory flow identity per SKU-location-review, separating optimizer-created from inherited stock
Part E: cycle stock economics - order quantity, cadence, MOQ, pack, freight breakpoints, ordering cost
Part F: pooled network stock - service-window pooling, correlation-aware risk pooling, fast-arc test
Part G: procurement timing against latest safe order date
Part H: service segmentation by customer, channel and SKU class
Part I: feasibility frontier, computed only where the standard solve is not obviously feasible
Part K/L: sector physics for fresh produce, meat/seafood and FMCG, with sector benchmark cells
Part M/N: action value, abstention reason codes and operator-facing explanations
Part O/P: data-quality diagnostics and confidence levels
rules: freeze the engine and record SHA, config hash and manifest before validation8
run validation8 once; no behavioural change after its results are viewed
do not reuse validation7; do not touch holdout4
keep every adverse result, every timeout row and every rejected hypothesis
never loosen validation settings to improve reported runtime
never rank candidates on cost differences smaller than the solver's own optimality gap
no claim of industry proof from synthetic benchmarks
